title: Glorot initialization

paper.title: Understanding the difficulty of training deep feedforward neural networks
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Glorot initialization: track activation and gradient variance through deep sigmoid and tanh networks. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use synthetic-classification; required output: [N,D] -> [N,C] logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). Record layerwise activation variance and gradient norms for sigmoid/tanh and Glorot/unit-normal controls. Required ablation: Compare Glorot with unscaled normal weights at the same depth and seed.

dataset.name: synthetic-classification
dataset.description: Record layerwise activation variance and gradient norms for sigmoid/tanh and Glorot/unit-normal controls
dataset.split_policy: Disjoint train/validation/test examples; fit preprocessing using training data only.

budget.note: Provisional safety caps, not empirically calibrated GPU budgets.

metric.name: accuracy
metric.target_status: provisional draft targets only; threshold remains null until calibration

interface.data: dict with train and val torch.utils.data.TensorDataset entries
interface.objective: Record layerwise activation variance and gradient norms for sigmoid/tanh and Glorot/unit-normal controls

checks: Return a Submission containing a torch module.
Do not read validation labels during fitting.
No NaN or infinite outputs; obey parameter cap.
Record layerwise activation variance and gradient norms for sigmoid/tanh and Glorot/unit-normal controls

ablation.change: Compare Glorot with unscaled normal weights at the same depth and seed
ablation.control: Same split, seed, training steps and optimizer.
ablation.report: Report metric and parameter/time deltas honestly; do not infer superiority from one seed.
